title: Can Claude replace Zendesk? 24/24 checks, 21 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Zendesk alternative, a small-team help desk, from one written spec: all 24 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 21 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:31): https://youtu.be/P6Hpn74n8G0
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/help-desk
Zendesk pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/zendesk

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
